title: JADES Imaging of GN-z11: Revealing the Morphology and Environment of a Luminous Galaxy 430 Myr after the Big Bang

evidence.locator: Section 3 (morphology), ForcePho fit of a point source, an extended Sérsic component and a haze: the extended component has Sérsic index n = 0.9 +/- 0.1, half-light radius along the major axis 49 +/- 3 mas (200 pc at z = 10.6), axis ratio q = 0.67 +/- 0.05, position angle 34 +/- 5 degrees, offset 21 mas from the point source. The haze has n = 0.9 +/- 0.1, half-light radius 0.11 +/- 0.01 arcsec, offset 0.41 arcsec, and is more likely a chance projection of a lower-redshift galaxy.
